svg.text: Corporate Mental Wellness & Counseling Platform — UML Component Diagram (Microservices)
Single entry point: routes requests, checks pseudo-ID tokens and staff logins, strips identifying headers (IP, email) before forwarding
Provided interface (ball): service the component offers
Required interface (socket): service the component needs
Assembly connector: socket plugged into ball
Labels: interface name and protocol / technology
E1–E5: Lab 2 epics · A-04, A-05: Lab 1 actors
Privacy rule (FR-001, FR-003, FR-006): only the Anonymous Identity service handles pseudo-ID tokens; the other services store pseudo-IDs only,
never names, emails or employee IDs. Wellness Analytics receives aggregates for groups of 10 or more, so HR cannot single out an employee (FR-004, FR-005).
